# glinet_zerotier (Resource)

Manages ZeroTier on the router. The router has one ZeroTier configuration, so use one instance of this resource. When ZeroTier is enabled, the router joins the ZeroTier network `network_id`. A private network must still authorize the router in the ZeroTier network controller; this resource does not do that. The router takes up to about 11 seconds to apply a write that enables ZeroTier. When `enabled` is `false`, the provider only disables ZeroTier, and the router keeps its previous network ID, `lan_enabled` and `wan_enabled`: the configured `network_id`, `lan_enabled` and `wan_enabled` are kept in the Terraform state and get to the router only when ZeroTier is enabled. While the router reports ZeroTier as disabled, the provider does not compare them with the router. Destroy disables ZeroTier on the router. The router keeps its network ID after a destroy, because the router API cannot remove it. Tested only with a network ID that does not exist: what `lan_enabled` and `wan_enabled` do on a router that is connected to a ZeroTier network was not verified.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "glinet_zerotier" "this" {
  enabled     = true
  network_id  = var.zerotier_network_id
  lan_enabled = true
}

variable "zerotier_network_id" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether ZeroTier runs on the router (`enabled` in the router API).
- `network_id` (String, Sensitive) ID of the ZeroTier network that the router joins, 16 hexadecimal digits in lower case (`id` in the router API). It is sensitive, because the ID of a public network is all that a device needs to join it.

### Optional

- `lan_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the devices in the ZeroTier network can get remote access to the LAN of the router (`lan_enabled` in the router API). Defaults to `false`.
- `wan_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the devices in the ZeroTier network can get remote access to the WAN of the router (`wan_enabled` in the router API). Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `zerotier`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is always "zerotier".
terraform import glinet_zerotier.this zerotier
```
